title: Three Winters and One Short Clock
subtitle: 生活惯习 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生活惯习（人与自我·生活与学习·丰富、充实、积极向上的生活）
meta: 主题语境：生活惯习（人与自我·生活与学习·丰富、充实、积极向上的生活）　|　核心词汇：habit　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 habit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the teacher ① kept a habit that no pupil in the school would have described, and he said the keeping was the whole of the winter. The ② habit, meaning the practice itself and not the clock, ran three winters and stayed undescribed in the book; a habit, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ habit in that school had the same short clock beside it, and the ④ habit at the far desk, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A habit, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the habit was the whole of the matter, meaning the custom and not the practice. The ⑥ habit, meaning the custom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; habit, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a practice and a custom. He said the custom is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ habit had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short clock. The ⑧ habit of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in November, was one school and three winters of describing; habit, he said, is either the one at the far desk or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ habit I remember is the one described in the notebook, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ habit, my mother said in 1977, is the only one that improves by being described; every habit, she said, is a custom that has agreed to look like a practice. She said the custom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 习惯（指学校里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 习惯（指那种做法本身，与时钟相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a habit 保持一个习惯
D. n. 习惯（指留给孩子们学着养成的那一个）
E. n. 习性（抽象总称，指一所学校的习惯之事）
F. n. 习惯（指笔记本里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 惯常；习性（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 惯常（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept a habit that no pupil in the school would have described
The habit, meaning the practice itself and not the clock
the habit at the far desk
the habit was the whole of the matter
the habit had become a line in a notebook
The habit of the whole thing
A habit, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: keep a habit 意为“保持一个习惯”，1968 年那位老师保持了学校里没有一位学生肯描述的一个习惯。
habit 意为“习惯”，指那种做法本身而不是时钟，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被描述。
habit 意为“习惯”，指学校里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只矮矮的时钟。
habit 意为“习惯”，指最远那张课桌上留给孩子们学着养成的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
habit 意为“惯常、习性”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份习性是那件事的全部。
habit 意为“惯常”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个习惯，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
habit 意为“习惯”，指笔记本里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1973 年这一个成了本子里的一行。
habit 意为“习性”，老师十一月写道，整件事的习惯之事是一所学校和三个冬天的描述。
habit 意为“习惯”，我记得的是笔记本里描述过的那一个，1975 年改掉了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一个。
habit 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，一个习惯是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的习性。
